hero.title: Beyond These Stars
hero.description: Beyond These Stars is the space-whale city builder from Balancing Monkey Games, published by Hooded Horse — build a sprawling city on the back of Kewa the space whale, manage supply chains and your people's needs as you journey through the galaxy seeking purpose and answers. Released at 1.0 on October 16, 2026 after skipping early access entirely, with a 20% launch discount on Steam. This wiki covers it from launch day: the beginner guides, the resource and supply chain mechanics, city layout tips, Kewa and the journey, and how it connects to Before We Leave.

aboutGame.title: What Is Beyond These Stars?
paragraphs: Beyond These Stars is a city-building strategy game from Balancing Monkey Games, the New Zealand studio behind Before We Leave, published by strategy specialists Hooded Horse. Your people — the Pequeninos — settle on the back of Kewa, a space whale swimming through the galaxy, and you build their civilization across that living, curved landscape: homes and schools, farms and factories, supply chains stretching from the whale's fin to its tail, all while the journey unfolds and the stars outside change.

The development story is part of the game's identity: originally planned for early access, the studio announced in March 2026 that Beyond These Stars would skip that phase entirely and ship as a complete 1.0 — and on October 16, 2026, it did, launching on Steam and the Epic Games Store with a 20% launch discount. This wiki is the launch-day companion: the guides, the mechanics, the comparisons, written from play and updated as the community maps the whale.

items.question: Is Beyond These Stars out?
items.answer: Yes — the full 1.0 released on October 16, 2026 on Steam and the Epic Games Store, with a 20% launch discount on Steam. The game skipped its originally planned early access phase entirely and shipped complete.

items.question: What is Beyond These Stars about?
items.answer: It's a city builder where your people settle on the back of Kewa, a space whale journeying through the galaxy. You manage supply chains and your citizens' needs on a living, curved landscape while the journey's story unfolds.

items.question: Is it in early access?
items.answer: No. The developers at Balancing Monkey Games announced in March 2026 that the game would skip early access and launch as a complete 1.0 — and it did, in October 2026.

items.question: Do I need to play Before We Leave first?
items.answer: No — Beyond These Stars is a semi-sequel with its own story and tutorial. The comparison page covers what carried over for fans of the original, but new players can start right here.
